field_convention: C_X in GeV^-2 multiplies scalar diquark coefficient evaluated at 2 GeV, including common running, generator and Fierz factors. 1/sqrt(abs(C_X)) is a contact scale, not the bare boson mass.
scope: single ordinary SU5 gauge boson multiplet; symmetric up mass in the physical 10, three effectively massless active neutrinos, one vectorlike 5 pair, leading heavy decoupling, orthonormal kinetic terms, no competing baryon-number-changing diagrams unless budgeted.
